vol.name: Hillbilly: The Treason of Twelve-Toe Maggie

title: Hillbilly: The Treason of Twelve-Toe Maggie #2
desc: As Rondel finds himself in the total control of Twelve-Toe Maggie and powerless to thwart her power-mad schemes, Leon goes on a dangerous quest to rescue his friend. But in order to free Rondel from the entrapment, he'll need to fight fire with fire and somehow convince another witch to join his cause.
